result:
Zed repo. Big cargo workspace, not single crate.

**Scale**: 236 member crates in `crates/`. 3754 files, ~54.5k symbols indexed. Core editor crate (`editor`) biggest, 71 outbound module deps.

**Structure — layers**:

- **GPUI** (`crates/gpui*`) — own UI/app framework, bottom layer. Own entity system, async, rendering. Platform backends split out: `gpui_macos`, `gpui_linux`, `gpui_windows`, `gpui_web`, `gpui_wgpu` (renderer).
- **Core text/lang engine**: `rope`, `text`, `sum_tree`, `language`, `language_core`, `multi_buffer`, `buffer_diff`, `syntax_theme` — buffer/rope data structures, tree-sitter grammar plumbing (`grammars` crate holds all `.scm` queries).
- **Project layer**: `project` (biggest non-editor hub, 40 out-deps) — LSP, git, DAP debugger, worktree mgmt all live under it (`src/lsp_store`, `src/debugger`, `src/git_store`). `fs`, `worktree` stuff, `remote`/`remote_server` for SSH remoting.
- **Editor UI**: `editor` crate itself (top out-degree, 71) — display map, folds, inlays, scroll. Surrounding UI crates: `workspace`, `ui`, `title_bar`, `picker`, `panel`, `search`, `outline_panel`, `project_panel`, `file_finder`, `vim` (vim mode), `terminal`/`terminal_view`.
- **AI/agent stack**: heavy chunk — `agent`, `agent_ui`, `agent_servers`, `agent_settings`, `agent_skills`, `language_model`(+`language_models`, `_core`, `_cloud`), plus per-provider crates: `anthropic`, `bedrock`, `google_ai`, `ollama`, `open_ai`, `mistral`, `deepseek`, `copilot`, `codestral`, `lmstudio`, `open_router`, `opencode`. `edit_prediction*` crates = separate predictive-completion pipeline.
- **Collab/backend**: `collab` (server, own binary, DB via `sqlez`), `rpc`, `proto` (protobuf wire format), `client`, `channel`, `call`, `livekit_api`/`livekit_client`.
- **Extensions**: `extension`, `extension_host` (wasm runtime), `extension_api`, `extension_cli` — wasm-based plugin system.
- **Settings/config**: `settings`, `settings_content`, `settings_ui`, `settings_json`, `migrator` (settings/keymap auto-migration).
- **App shell**: `zed` crate (top-level binary, `crates/zed/src/main.rs`, `zed.rs`), `cli`, `auto_update`.

Top external deps confirm arch: `gpui` (1017 imports) dominant, then `anyhow`, `collections` (custom), `futures`, `parking_lot`.

Entry points: `crates/zed/src/main.rs` (app), `crates/cli/src/main.rs`, `crates/collab/src/main.rs` (server), `crates/remote_server/src/main.rs`.

Want deps drilldown on any piece (e.g. what `agent` crate pulls in)?
